response:
FADE IN:

EXT. CASTLE - DAY

The majestic castle of King Reginald III stands tall, its stone walls bearing the weight of centuries. But amidst the grandeur, a subtle yet revolutionary change is unfolding.

CUT TO:

INT. THRONE ROOM - DAY

King Reginald III, a stout and proud monarch, sits upon his throne, surrounded by his loyal advisors. But instead of the traditional regalia, he wears a sleek, pastel-colored jumpsuit, complete with a neon-lit crown.

REGINALD
(to his advisors)
My friends, I have a vision. Our empire's aesthetic must evolve. We must tap into the futuristic, the avant-garde, the... (he searches for the right words)...the "wet"!

ADVISOR 1
(confused)
Your Majesty, what do you mean by "wet"?

REGINALD
(excitedly)
I mean, we must infuse our empire with the essence of... (he consults a parchment)...Vaporwave!

The advisors exchange skeptical glances, but Reginald presses on.

CUT TO:

EXT. CASTLE GROUNDS - DAY

The castle's courtyard is transformed into a surreal landscape. Water features, once mere decorative elements, now flow with a mesmerizing, slow-motion quality. The sound of dripping water and distant, distorted synths fills the air.

REGINALD
(to his advisors)
Behold! Our empire's new aesthetic is born!

ADVISOR 2
(sarcastically)
Yes, because nothing says "medieval majesty" like a water feature and some questionable fashion choices.

REGINALD
(firmly)
Silence, good sir! This is the future of our empire!

CUT TO:

INT. THRONE ROOM - DAY

Reginald's advisors are now dressed in their own Vaporwave-inspired attire, complete with neon-colored wigs and chunky, futuristic jewelry. The room is filled with an otherworldly glow, as if the very fabric of reality has been altered.

REGINALD
(to his advisors)
Now, let us proceed with the implementation of our new aesthetic. We shall make our empire the envy of all the land!

ADVISOR 3
(nervously)
Uh, Your Majesty, perhaps we should, uh, consult with the, uh, "experts" before making any further changes?

REGINALD
(dismissively)
Pfft, experts? Ha! I am the visionary! I shall lead our empire into a new era of... (he consults his parchment again)...Vaporwave-ness!

The advisors exchange worried glances, but Reginald remains resolute, his eyes shining with an unsettling intensity.

FADE TO BLACK.

FADE IN:

EXT. CASTLE - DAY

The camera pans across the castle's facade, now adorned with a garish, neon-lit mural depicting a futuristic, dystopian landscape. The sound of distant, distorted synths and the hum of machinery fills the air.

REGINALD
(voiceover)
The future is now. And it's... wet.

FADE TO BLACK.
